epsilon_cliff.note: eps(n) = eps0*sigmoid((n-cliff_start)/cliff_slope). Measured eps=0 for n<=100, so headline runs keep it off; E8 sweeps eps0/cliff_start/cliff_slope.

trigger.note: horizon_cap = 1/h at the old engine drift hazard h=0.02 (Theorem 2 lifetime, 50 uses); threshold carries manifest externality m*t (methods-v2 s2 extension), inert at m=0. buy_formula: how the trigger prices an attempt -- 'full' = Algorithm 1 B_hat = C + (1/p_hat - 1)*C_fail (default since W1.5, 2026-09-19; at C_fail = C it evaluates C/p_hat exactly, so rows without a measured C_fail_mult are unchanged), 'narrow' = the pre-W1.5 C/p_hat for bitwise reproduction of old rows; see sim.BUY_FORMULA_DOC. As everywhere else, absent mechanism keys (gate_prior, spend_cap) fall back to the historical defaults in sim.py.

deployment.note: Deployment options (docs/harder-families-and-routers.md part B). Absent or omitted keys fall back to the code defaults in sim.py, which are the measured full-listing router, a monotone library and the one-demonstration compiler -- i.e. exactly what E3/E4/E5/E8 were run with. Only the E4_crn / E4_evict / E4_retrieval / E4_kmin3 experiments read this block.

retrieval_router.note: tau = tau0 + m*min(k,n), flat in n once the library has k entries (Voyager top-5, RAG-MCP, SkillOps, PreAct). eps_recall_per_decade is SkillOps' 200 -> 2,000 sweep (worst arm 7.5 SR points per decade of n); eps_select is the shortlist floor at k, which has an interior optimum (SkillRouter K=20 beats K=50 by 2.0 pp). Set eps_enabled=false to price the token side alone.

hierarchical_router.note: tau = 2*tau0 + m_g*G + m*ceil(n/G) at G = sqrt(n*m/m_g); m_group null means m_g = m, i.e. about 2*m*sqrt(n) (AnyTool, MCP-Zero, HiSkill, Graph-of-Skills).

eviction.note: Delist a program after T stream arrivals without a use. T may be a number or "t_star", the closed form T* = (1/lambda) ln(C_eff*lambda/m) evaluated from the family's own online lambda_hat. v_min is the evidence floor: no entry may be delisted before it has been offered v_min routing opportunities (D2Skill T_prot = 10, WhenToForget V_min = 10). Relisting costs zero compile tokens; see sim.EVICTION_DOC.

deployment.k_min_note: k_min demonstrations before a family may be compiled. 1 is the deployed protocol and is inert; 3 is the AutoRPA-style protocol. Per-layout C(k), p(k) go in cost_sets.<set>.layouts.<layout>.k_table as {"3": {"C_scale": 1.4, "p_scale": 1.0}} -- prefer the _scale form, because the price ladder overwrites an absolute C.
